description: IEA Wind Task 37 publishes this 15-megawatt offshore reference-turbine model through the IEA Wind Systems repository. It includes OpenFAST and HAWC2 aeroelastic inputs, WISDEM optimisation files, turbine-ontology YAML and available CAD representations, with separate documentation for a semisubmersible support platform. Users select operating and environmental conditions and run the appropriate external solver to obtain turbine response and performance. Coverage is a generic reference design, not a measured operating plant; simulation duration and resolution follow the chosen solver. Public model files and documentation are free under Apache-2.0, while external solvers retain their own terms. A limitation is version coupling: OpenFAST inputs require compatible ROSCO controls and release-specific settings, and community ports to other products are separate contributions. The reference design does not establish certified performance of a commercial turbine. It supports comparable offshore-wind design and loading studies around OpenFAST, complementary to the catalogue's wind-turbine digital twin (model-wtdigitwin-wind-turbine-digital-twin). The repository identifies the 2020 reference-turbine and floating-support reports. No turbine deck, CAD file, executable or report PDF was downloaded.
